name: Lisa Zevi
subject: the coo in a box line

beats.hook: You call yourself "COO in a BOX" on your LinkedIn, a tagline I haven't seen from another coach. It saves you a whole paragraph.
beats.identity: You're easy to introduce. 12 meetings for the last business coach I worked with in Dubai, and 5 of them became clients.
beats.offer: I went and found 10 names already. People here who'd be worth the meeting.
beats.cta: 15 minutes and they're yours the same day. I'll tell you why these 10 and not the other 40.
beats.ps: ps: a straight no is a fine answer, and costs you nothing.
